items.title: Add `--show-urls` and `--only-downloads` to `uv python list`
items.reason: Introduced the explicit `--only-downloads` mode that displays downloadable interpreters when the default listing omits them.

items.title: [feat] `uv python upgrade` or `uv python install --upgrade`
items.reason: Canonical historical discussion of broad Python requests being satisfied by an installed patch and requiring an explicit upgrade operation.

items.title: Add support for `--upgrade` in `uv python install`
items.reason: Added the applicable operation: `uv python install 3.14 --upgrade` installs the latest patch despite an older matching installation.

related.search_scope: Authenticated searches covered exact identifiers and fragments (`3.14.8`, `python-downloads`, `manual`, `uv python list`, `uv python install 3`, `already installed`, macOS x86_64), conceptual availability and latest-patch terminology, and fix-oriented history across issues and pull requests in all states. Candidate comments and reference chains were inspected. astral-sh/uv#19788 was ruled out because it concerned a genuinely unavailable new build, whereas 3.14.8 is explicitly listable and installable here. astral-sh/uv#9437 concerns missing-interpreter error guidance rather than list visibility.

type_reason: Repository source and a maintainer comment confirm that this is intended behavior: with manual downloads, the default list omits download records unless `--only-downloads` is supplied, and broad install requests do not upgrade matching installations unless `--upgrade` is supplied. Since 3.14.8 is available, the remaining request is a usability or documentation improvement.
summary: No duplicate tracks the primary request to reconsider download visibility under manual mode. The closest items establish the explicit listing and upgrade mechanisms; the superficially similar release-availability report astral-sh/uv#19788 has a different underlying problem.
draft_response: This is not a missing x86_64 macOS build: `uv python list --only-downloads` and the successful exact install confirm that 3.14.8 is available. With `python-downloads = "manual"`, the default list intentionally requires `--only-downloads`, added in astral-sh/uv#8062, to show the download catalog. Likewise, an existing 3.14.7 satisfies `uv python install 3`; use `uv python install 3.14 --upgrade`, supported by astral-sh/uv#16676, to request the latest patch. We can keep this open as an enhancement to consider whether the listing behavior or its documentation should be clearer.
